notes: Read all 59 numbered source lines before editing. L1 useState/useMemo, L2 react-i18next useTranslation, L3 lucide Lock icon, L4 shared ui Input/Select, L5 ../ToolCard, L6 shared ui CopyButton, L7 ../constants PERMS, L9-11 the UnixPermissionTool body (octal state), L13-16 the symbolic memo, L18-25 the six presetOptions, L27-57 the JSX (ToolCard > Input + Select grid > Owner/Group/Other triads > code+CopyButton row), and L59 the closing brace were each considered and reproduced natively.

Self-contained by necessity (same precedent as the sibling CronParser.tsx and InfrastructureSection.tsx in this folder): the modules the source imports are NOT separate native parity targets — L5 ../ToolCard, L7 ../constants, and the L4/L6 shared web ui Input/Select/CopyButton would never resolve from native. So ToolCard (green variant), the labelled Input, the Presets selector and the CopyButton are reproduced natively in this one file, and the PERMS map (constants.ts L68-77: '7'->rwx '6'->rw- '5'->r-x '4'->r-- '3'->-wx '2'->-w- '1'->--x '0'->---) is inlined VERBATIM (plain TS, no DOM). The port is longer than the 59-line source because the web logic was split across ToolCard + constants + shared ui.

Behaviour/state preserved verbatim: state name octal seeded '755' (L11). The symbolic memo (L13-16) is byte-for-byte logic: returns null unless octal.length===3 && /^[0-7]{3}$/.test(octal), else (PERMS[octal[0] ?? '0'] ?? '---') + (PERMS[octal[1] ?? '0'] ?? '---') + (PERMS[octal[2] ?? '0'] ?? '---'), with the [octal] dep. The six presetOptions (L18-25) keep their exact value/label pairs: 755 (rwxr-xr-x), 644 (rw-r--r--), 700 (rwx------), 600 (rw-------), 777 (rwxrwxrwx), 444 (r--r--r--). symbolic.slice(0,3)/slice(3,6)/slice(6) feed Owner/Group/Other (L38,L42,L46). The Input onChange->onChangeText->setOctal (L31) and each preset's onChange->setOctal(value) (L32) are preserved; React key={opt.value} (mapped from L19-24) is kept.

i18n intent preserved: react-i18next is not wired in native, so useTranslation()'s t (L10) is replaced by useNativeTranslationFallback returning the i18n key when no default is supplied (i18next returns the key for a missing translation). Every key is preserved verbatim: 'Unix Perm' + 'Unix Perm Desc' (L28), 'Octal Perm' (L31), 'Presets' (L32), 'Owner' (L37), 'Group' (L41), 'Other' (L45). The reproduced CopyButton uses the shared CopyButton's keys 'common.copyButton.copy'/'common.copyButton.copied' with English defaults Copy/Copied, plus a native-only 'common.copyButton.unavailable' hint backing the degraded-clipboard state.

Visual intent preserved: ToolCard icon=Lock color=green (L28) -> a green ICON_COLOR_MAP ring (bg rgba(52,211,153,0.10) + border rgba(52,211,153,0.20) + colors.success glyph) carrying an 'LK' glyph; the Input leading Lock icon (L31) -> a muted 'LK' leading glyph (sibling CronParser 'TM' / InfrastructureSection 'DB'/'GB' precedent). div space-y-3 (L29) -> rowGap 12. The Owner/Group/Other boxes (L36-47): rounded bg-[var(--surface-overlay)] px-3 py-2 text-center -> the dark --surface-overlay rgba(15,23,42,0.5) box, centered, with text-xs text-secondary labels and font-mono text-sm values colored text-emerald-300 #6ee7b7 (Owner), text-cyan-300 #67e8f9 (Group), text-amber-300 #fcd34d (Other). The code+CopyButton row (L51-54): flex items-center gap-2 rounded bg-[var(--surface-overlay)] px-3 py-2 with a font-mono text-white <code> (colors.textPrimary, Menlo/monospace) + the CopyButton. GlassPanel/Input/Select/CopyButton and div/span/p/code/input/select become the shared native GlassPanel + RN View/TextInput/Pressable + AppText.

Native-safe adaptations (documented above): (1) the web <select> Presets dropdown (L32) becomes a labelled flex-wrap row of single-select preset chips (Pressable) — the chip whose value===octal is highlighted via accessibilityState.selected + a green tint, reflecting the dropdown's value={octal} binding, and tapping runs setOctal(opt.value); this is the native-idiomatic equivalent of a small fixed-option select and preserves the options/value/onChange semantics. (2) The grid sm:grid-cols-2 Input|Select (L30) collapses to a vertical stack (the source's sub-sm/mobile rendering). (3) The grid sm:grid-cols-3 triads (L35) render as a 3-up row of equal flex:1 boxes, preserving the Owner|Group|Other side-by-side visual grouping (each box holds only a short label + 3-char mono value). (4) The CopyButton's navigator.clipboard.writeText is reproduced with a native-safe writeClipboard that uses navigator.clipboard when present (react-native-web) and reports an explicit unavailable state on iOS/Android where no clipboard module is bundled, never flipping to 'Copied' on failure (web parity). The native TextInput adds keyboardType='number-pad' + maxLength=3 as octal-entry affordances; the [0-7]{3} memo validation is unchanged so behaviour is identical.

No DOM, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, browser HTML elements (div/span/p/code/input/select), or old web ui components are imported — only react-native primitives (Platform/Pressable/StyleSheet/TextInput/View), React hooks, and the shared native GlassPanel + AppText + theme tokens. The file has no API calls, no dates, and no unit-bearing values. An optional style + testID prop pair was added for native composability (defaults to {} and a stable 'unix-permission-tool' testID), plus a displayName + default export matching the sibling CronParser port.
